name: UP Chana Dal
ingredients: Green chilli, jeera, hing and turmeric
steps: Pressure-cook until soft but not mushy.
Combine and simmer; add coriander and lemon.
note: Lentils offer plant protein and fibre; skip the ghee tempering.

inspirationReferences.title: Chana Dal Recipe (Split Bengal Gram)
inspirationReferences.note: North Indian chana-dal soaking, pressure-cooking and onion-tomato tempering technique; our UP seasoning profile is independently developed.
